an7.74:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, arako nāma satthā ahosi, titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo:
an7.74:1.2: arakassa kho pana bhikkhave, satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
an7.74:1.3: arako satthā sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
an7.74:1.4: appakaṃ brāhmaṇā, jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahupāyāsaṃ mantāya boddhabbaṃ kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
an7.74:2.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā, tiṇagge ussāvabindu suriye uggacchante khippameva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti,
an7.74:2.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇā, ussāvabindupamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ, mantāya boddhabbaṃ. kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
an7.74:3.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā, thullaphusitake deve vassante udakabubbūḷaṃ khippameva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti,
an7.74:3.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇā, udakabubbūḷūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ, mantāya boddhabbaṃ. kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
an7.74:4.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā, udake daṇḍarājī khippaṃ yeva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
an7.74:4.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇā, udake daṇḍa rājūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ …pe…
an7.74:5.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā, nadī pabbateyyā dūraṅgamā sīghasotā hārahārīnī natthi so khaṇo vā layo vā muhutto vā yaṃ sātharati, atha kho sā gacchateva vattateva sandateva,
an7.74:5.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇā, nadīpabbateyyupamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ …pe…
an7.74:6.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā, balavā puriso jivhagge kheḷapiṇḍaṃ saññuhitvā appakasireneva vameyya,
an7.74:6.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇā khelapiṇḍūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ …pe…
an7.74:7.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā, divasasaṃtatte ayokaṭāhe maṃsapesī pakkhittā khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
an7.74:7.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇā, maṃsapesūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ …pe…
an7.74:8.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇā, gāvī vajjhā āghātanaṃ nīyamānā yaññadeva pādaṃ uddharati santikeva hoti vadhassa santikeva maraṇassa,
an7.74:8.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, gāvī vajjhūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ mantāya boddhabbaṃ. kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇanti.
an7.74:9.1: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ saṭṭhivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. pañcavassasatikā kumārikā alampateyyā ahosi.
an7.74:9.2: tena kho pana bhikkhave, samayena manussānaṃ chaḷeva ābādhā ahesuṃ:
an7.74:9.3: sītaṃ, uṇhaṃ, jigacchā, pipāsā, uccāro, passāvo.
an7.74:9.4: so hi nāma bhikkhave, arako satthā evaṃ dīghāyukesu manussesu evaṃ ciraṭṭhitikesu evaṃ appābādhesu sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desessati:
an7.74:9.5: ”appakaṃ brāhmaṇā, jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ mantāya boddhabbaṃ. kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. natthi jātassa amaraṇa”nti.
an7.74:10.1: etarahi kho taṃ bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an7.74:10.2: appakaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ mantāya boddhabbaṃ. kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. natthi jātassa amaraṇanti.
an7.74:10.3: etarahi kho bhikkhave, yo ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo vā.
an7.74:10.4: vassasataṃ kho pana bhikkhave, jīvanto tīṇiyeva utusatāni jīvati:
an7.74:10.5: utusataṃ hemantānaṃ, utusataṃ gimhānaṃ, utusataṃ vassānaṃ.
an7.74:10.6: tīṇi kho pana bhikkhave, utusatāni jīvanto dvādasayeva māsasatāni jīvati:
an7.74:10.7: cattāri māsasatāni hemantānaṃ, cattāri māsasatāni gimhānaṃ, cattāri māsasatāni vassānaṃ.
an7.74:10.8: dvādasaṃ kho, pana bhikkhave, māsasatāni jīvanto catuvīsatiṃ eva addhamāsa satāni jīvati:
an7.74:10.9: aṭṭhaddha māsasatāni hemantānaṃ aṭṭhaddhamāsasatāni gimhānaṃ, aṭṭhaddhamāsasatāni vassānaṃ.
an7.74:10.10: catuvīsatiṃ kho pana bhikkhave, aṭṭhaddhamāsasatāni jīvanto chattiṃsaṃyeva ratti sahassāni jīvati:
an7.74:10.11: dvādasa rattisahassāni hemantānaṃ, dvādasarattisahassāni gimhānaṃ, dvādasarattisahassāni vassānaṃ.
an7.74:10.12: chattiṃsaṃ kho pana bhikkhave, ratti sahassāni jīvanto dvesattatiṃ eva bhattasahassāni bhuñjati:
an7.74:10.13: catuvīsati bhattasahassāni hemantānaṃ, catuvīsati bhattasahassāni gimhānaṃ, catuvīsati bhattasahassāni vassānaṃ saddhiṃ mātuthaññāya, saddhiṃ bhattantarāya.
an7.74:11.1: tatrime bhattantarāyā: kupitopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, dukkhitopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, vyādhitopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, uposathikopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, alābhakenapi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati.
an7.74:11.2: iti kho bhikkhave, mayā vassasatāyukassa manussassa āyupi saṅkhātaṃ, āyuppamāṇampi saṅkhātaṃ, utupi saṅkhātā, saṃvaccharāpi saṅkhātā, māsāpi saṅkhātā, addhamāsāpi saṅkhātā, rattipi saṅkhātā, divāpi saṅkhātā, bhattāpi saṅkhātā, bhattantarāyāpi saṅkhātā.
an7.74:11.3: yaṃ bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya,
an7.74:11.4: kataṃ vo taṃ mayā. etāni bhikkhave, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. jhāyatha bhikkhave, māpamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
